integrity: The six finite-field cases are completely enumerated. General statements depend on the explicit block-count and cut-bound proof; enumeration alone is not an infinite proof.
mathematical_scope: Uniformly sampled invertible, labeled structure matrices over finite fields; sharp failure inequalities for n at least 16, exact component counts for every positive n; uniform q-asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Sampling is over labeled matrices, not isomorphism classes.
Singular-matrix indecomposability and sparse random patterns are outside the claim.
An earlier graph-support or random-matrix theorem could imply an equivalent result; absolute historical priority is unverified.
No independent mathematical audit or expert validation has been performed.
title: Sharp simplicity–indecomposability gap for random perfect evolution algebras
